category: Category A — General Conversational and Domain Tests
name: Draft a letter
expected: Asks what kind of letter and identifies whether it concerns a tenancy, employment, or consumer legal matter.
prompt: Can you help me draft a letter?
raw_response:
Hello! I would be glad to help you draft a formal legal demand letter or notice. 

To make sure the document is accurate and covers everything you need, could you please share a few quick details about your situation? Specifically, let me know which domain this falls under (Tenant & Landlord Dispute, Consumer Protection, or Employment Issue) and provide the key facts such as names, dates, amounts involved, and the specific relief or payment you are seeking.

citations.title: Criteria for giving legal services (Free Legal Aid via NALSA / SLSA / DLSA)
citations.description: Provides free competent legal services to eligible persons, including women, children, industrial workmen, and persons with annual income below specified statutory thresholds.

citations.title: Statutory Payment of Earned Salary and Notice Pay for Private/Commercial Employees
citations.description: State-specific legislation (e.g., Delhi Shops Act, Karnataka Shops & Commercial Establishments Act, Maharashtra Shops Act) governing commercial and IT/office establishments. Mandates clearance of earned wages and final settlement upon termination or resignation within 3 to 15 days.

citations.title: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract
citations.description: When a contract has been broken, the party who suffers by such breach is entitled to receive, from the party who has broken the contract, compensation for any loss or damage caused to him thereby.
